A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, Towards flexible perception with visual memory. All 26 pages of each version are readable, including nine tables, fourteen figures and Appendices A–K. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments, including aggregation comparisons, Gemini re-ranking, NINCO class additions, memory scaling and pruning, with additional empirical analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original classification, scaling, class-addition and pruning results, together with appendix sensitivity, calibration and qualitative analyses. These remain original empirical results despite being unchanged from v1.

M1.justification: The fixed DinoV2/CLIP embeddings, nearest-neighbor retrieval, RankVoting, Gemini re-ranking, memory pruning and hierarchical prediction algorithm are unchanged, including their definitions in Section 2 and Appendices G–H.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ImageNet-1K/JFT memory experiments, NINCO class additions, iNaturalist21 hierarchy experiments, ImageNet distribution-shift benchmarks and compositionality examples. No evaluated dataset, task or scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments, including PluralityVoting, DistanceVoting, SoftmaxVoting, no aggregation, linear probing, the CLIP zero-shot reference and Gemini without neighbors (Section 2.2; Tables 1–9).

E3.justification: Model variants, memory sizes, label processing, metrics and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Both retain 50-neighbor Gemini re-ranking and Appendix G's sweep over k=1–100 for pruning comparisons.

E4.justification: The pruning comparisons, hyperparameter sensitivity, hit-rate analysis, NINCO distance analysis, calibration, ImageNet-A error examples and compositionality analyses are retained without alteration (Section 3.5; Appendices C–K).

E5.justification: Repeated-run and seed disclosure, uncertainty reporting and statistical procedures are unchanged. Figure 11's distance boxplots are identical, and no confidence intervals or significance comparisons are added.

E6.justification: Reported scores, curves and qualitative examples match throughout both PDFs. Both report 88.5% ImageNet accuracy for Gemini re-ranking and 84.1% for RankVoting with soft pruning (Section 2.2; Table 3). No result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: The memory/retrieval definitions, voting formulas, scaling-law equations and pruning formulas are unchanged. No formal assumption, theorem, proof or derivation is added, removed or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution highlights and discussion summary retain the same claims about flexible visual memory, RankVoting, Gemini re-ranking, scaling, unlearning, pruning and interpretability.

C2.justification: Section 4 removes the specific rationale that visual memory would benefit image generation because retraining large generative models whenever data are added or removed is prohibitively expensive. The proposed extensions, fixed-embedding limitation, distribution-shift caveat and flexibility–accuracy trade-off remain.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-and-data availability statement and a google-deepmind/visual-memory repository link on page 2; v1 lacks this access information. Implementation and hyperparameter descriptions are unchanged. The PDFs do not establish the repository's contents or usability.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, all 69 references and the positioning relative to earlier memory and nearest-neighbor approaches are unchanged.

P1.justification: Localized edits add the resource-access sentence, shorten the future-work paragraph, update version/date text and acknowledge Rebecca Bland and Phoebe Kirk for legal advice. Section ordering, terminology and the broader narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added sentence causes small text-flow changes across pages 2–7 and shifts Tables 1–2 slightly downward; page 12 also reflows. Figure artwork, table structures, captions and numbering are unchanged. All appendix pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 supplies a concrete code-and-data access pointer that v1 lacked, improving resource discoverability and reproducibility documentation. Scientific evidence and appendices are unchanged, while removing the brief image-generation cost rationale has little effect on the retained argument. The supported improvement is limited to documentation; repository contents and usability cannot be verified from the PDFs.
